supersedes.reason: The v2 wire schema was accepted, but all five completed responses exhausted the 4096-token combined MEDIUM-thinking and candidate budget. The run was aborted and preserved before this revision. A one-page LOW-thinking diagnostic returned STOP with 2307 candidate and zero thinking tokens.

purpose: Measure Gemini 3.7 Flash as the primary candidate on the frozen CGPG Complete OCR holdout. Azure Document Intelligence remains the unexecuted contract control, so this run cannot select a production provider.

provider.name: google_gemini_api
provider.request_asset: The frozen full-page JPEG with no crop, local OCR text, local geometry, or ground-truth hint.
provider.response_contract: Strict ordered line records containing verbatim text, a direct normalized page-relative line box, and a contiguous zero-based reading_order.
provider.wire_bbox_contract: Exactly four integers in ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax order.
provider.local_bbox_contract: The strict parser independently rejects values outside normalized 0..1000 and rejects degenerate or out-of-page boxes.

corpus.name: Corpus of Ground-truthed Patrologia Graeca
corpus.selection: The lexicographically first 12 non-empty pages of the deterministic CGPG holdout.
corpus.single_column_limitation: This slice supplies only single-column Greek evidence; it cannot establish multi-column, mixed-language, block-order, or general layout performance.

design.input_parity: Every repetition receives the byte-identical frozen JPEG for its page.
design.run_validity: Failures remain failures and are not replaced or retried. Missing or changed frozen inputs abort before model calls.

cost.interpretation: The result reports a tariff calculation from provider usage counters. It is not an actual bill without billing-export evidence.

security.credential_source: The existing translation-project settings are read only in the parent process.
security.credential_transfer: The key is passed only in a scrubbed one-shot child-process environment; it is absent from argv, stdout, evidence, repository files, and raw response files.
security.uploaded_content: Only the frozen JPEG bytes; PAGE XML ground truth is never uploaded.
security.raw_outputs: Private ignored directory mode 0700 with files mode 0600; no raw OCR text is committed.

decision.rule: This primary-only measurement cannot select Gemini or any other production OCR provider.

content_policy.forbidden: Images, OCR text, ground-truth text, coordinates, paths, endpoints, account identifiers, credentials, headers, and raw provider errors are excluded from committed evidence.
